study_type_evidence.quote: BALB/c nude mice were intravenously injected with free DOX (3 mg/kg) or Al-ProD (3 mg/kg based on DOX contents)
First, 5 × 103 MDA-MB231 or H9C2 cells were seeded in 96-well cell culture plates.
HSA-bound Al-ProD was incubated with enzyme reaction buffer containing cathepsin B (MES buffer; 50 µg/mL).

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: six-week-old female BALB/c nude mice; tumour-bearing animals carried subcutaneous MDA-MB231 xenografts
in_vivo_species.quote: Six-week-old female Balb/c nude mice were purchased from NaraBio, Inc. (Seoul, Korea).

in_vitro_detail: Albumin binding of Al-ProD assessed against purified human, mouse and bovine serum albumin in PBS (SDS-PAGE, RP-HPLC, MALDI-TOF); enzyme selectivity against recombinant cathepsin B, D, E, L, caspase-3 and caspase-9 in buffer; cellular uptake, western blot and CCK-8 cytotoxicity in MDA-MB231 breast cancer cells and H9C2 rat cardiomyoblasts, with cathepsin B-inhibitory siRNA as a control.

agents.chemical_identifier: C64H83N13O21; calculated molecular weight 1370.44 Da, measured 1370.616 m/z [M] by MALDI-TOF; FRRG peptide synthesised by Peptron (Daejeon, Republic of Korea)
agents.dose: 3 mg/kg (based on DOX contents), single injection for the PK and biodistribution studies; once every three days for the efficacy study
agents.dose_route_quote: BALB/c nude mice were intravenously injected with free DOX (3 mg/kg) or Al-ProD (3 mg/kg based on DOX contents)
agents.half_life_matrix: blood plasma of BALB/c nude mice (DOX fluorescence in DMSO extracts of blood)
agents.auc: no absolute value reported; stated only as approximately sevenfold higher than free DOX
agents.pk_quote: Al-ProD showed a significantly extended half-life of more than 3 h (Figure 4a).

agents.dose_route_quote: the mice were intravenously injected with free DOX (3 mg/kg) or Al-ProD (3 mg/kg based on DOX contents)
agents.half_life_matrix: blood plasma of BALB/c nude mice

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Pharmacokinetics and biodistribution of Al-ProD. (a) PK profiles of Al-ProD and free DOX.
concentration_time_figure.note: Plasma DOX-fluorescence versus time after a single intravenous dose; blood was sampled at 0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 24, 48, 72, 96, 120 and 144 h. AUC was calculated from this curve with Origin 2020 software.

bioanalytical_method: IVIS Lumina Series III fluorescence imaging of DOX fluorescence in DMSO extracts of blood plasma (non-chromatographic); NIRF imaging with the same instrument for tissue biodistribution
bioanalytical_quote: amount of free DOX and Al-ProD in samples was analyzed by IVIS Lumina Series III system
notes: PK was measured by whole-plasma DOX fluorescence on an IVIS imager rather than by a chromatographic assay, so the reported half-lives are fluorescence-decay half-lives of total DOX signal. The body never states the number of animals in the PK arm, nor group sizes for any in vivo arm, so group_n is 'not reported' throughout. The half-life for Al-ProD is given only as an inequality ('more than 3 h') and no phase is named anywhere in the body, hence half_life_phase 'unspecified' and both phase-specific fields 'not reported'; the authors fitted no compartmental model and reported no rate constants. AUC evidence quote (verbatim, RESULTS): 'the area under the curve (AUC) of Al-ProD was approximately sevenfold increased compared with that of free DOX' - no units or absolute values are given. Additional in vivo timing detail: 'a detectable amount of the Al-ProD remained for 144 h in the body'. Note the paper uses the phrase 'ex vivo imaging' for fluorescence imaging of organs resected from dosed mice at 12 h; that is a readout of in vivo biodistribution rather than an ex vivo treatment of isolated tissue, so 'ex vivo' was not added to study_types. Albumin (HSA, MSA, BSA), recombinant cathepsins/caspases and cathepsin B-inhibitory siRNA were incubation partners or tools rather than administered/tested therapeutic substances and were not given agent objects. In vitro potency for reference: IC50 of HSA-bound Al-ProD was 7.33 uM in MDA-MB231 versus >200 uM in H9C2.
